blurb:
This full-day kayaking adventure goes beyond the typical Emerald Cave tour—lasting up to an hour longer than most and taking you deeper into the Black Canyon Narrows for a more immersive, unhurried experience. Visit Emerald, Echo, and Lover’s Caves, explore hidden inlets, and paddle through some of the canyon’s most remote stretches.

This is not a rushed out-and-back. With more time on the water, you’ll paddle at a relaxed pace, discovering off-the-beaten-path spots, spotting wildlife like bighorn sheep and bald eagles, and taking in views most paddlers never reach. Stop at a secluded sandy beach to swim, relax, or unwind, and opt for a short hike into a slot canyon that rewards with panoramic canyon views. 

Along the way, your guide captures hundreds of photos and videos, so you can stay in the moment while leaving with incredible memories.

With all gear, snacks, and drinks included—plus expert guides and small groups—this is the full-day tour you don’t want to miss.
